# Lingofisy

> Lingofisy is a language-learning mobile app for iOS and Android, launching
> with English, Turkish, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese.
> It offers Daily courses, vocabulary review and progress tracking. AI speaking
> is exclusively a paid Lingofisy Pro feature. The in-app coach is named Fisy.

Lingofisy is operated from Berlin, Germany by Rasul Mammadov. The app is in
development; the website currently announces it ahead of the App Store and
Google Play listings.

## What Lingofisy does

- **Placement first.** A short placement experience sets the starting level
  instead of dropping every learner into the same beginner track.
- **Short daily lessons.** Most daily activities take about 5 to 10 focused
  minutes, built around vocabulary, grammar, quizzes and sentence-building games.
- **AI speaking practice (Pro only).** Learners speak out loud and receive
  personalized feedback. Unlimited AI speaking requires a paid Lingofisy Pro
  subscription. The free plan includes no AI speaking access or free allowance.
- **Native-language support at A1 and A2.** Learners can view translations of
  explanations in the native language they select during onboarding.
- **Review that remembers.** Spaced repetition returns saved vocabulary before
  it is forgotten.
- **Progress tracking.** Streaks, XP, coins and weekly accuracy.

## Learning paths

- Daily English
- Daily Turkish
- Daily Russian
- Daily German
- Daily French
- Daily Italian
- Daily Spanish
- Daily Portuguese

Each Daily course focuses on everyday language learning.

## Who it is for

Learners who want practical language skills for everyday life, travel and
conversation in one of the eight launch languages.
